Catch regressions in peer eviction safeguards previously masked by fallback connection age checks
agreement: Verified via mutation testing that tests now fail when block protection is disabled (trakshan-mishra)
Addressed objection that libc++ and MSVC did not catch mutants due to netgroup sorting (instagibbs)
